subject: [hw] DONE V15 rev 3: PKH halves fixed (T01 finding F1)
body:
Rev 3 of V15 (T32 32-bit data processing). No interface change; two semantic fixes on top of rev 2, both from hw-t01s differential corpus.

1. PKHBT/PKHTB halves were swapped. Now (ARM ARM + clang oracle):
     PKHBT Rd = (Rn & 0xFFFF) | ((Rm << imm5) & 0xFFFF0000)
     PKHTB Rd = (Rn & 0xFFFF0000) | ((Rm ASR imm5) & 0xFFFF), imm5 == 0 -> Rm unchanged
   Evidence: clang compiles `(x&0xffff0000)|(y&0xffff)` to `pkhbt r0,r1,r0` and `(x&0xffff0000)|((y>>8)&0xffff)` to `pkhtb r0,r0,r1,asr #8`; llvm also canonicalises `pkhtb r0,r1,r2` to `pkhbt r0,r2,r1`, which is only equivalent with "imm5 == 0 means no shift". (Rev 2 had the ADC/SBC carry-in fix.)

2. Package test:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V15 PASS 1604/1604
    (ASan+UBSan -O1, then -O2; ~5 s; /tmp/n2hw-V15 only.)

3. Optional real-core check:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/check_routing.sh
    V15-ROUTE PASS 10/10

Also added since rev 2: 8 compiler-oracle spot checks recorded in STATUS (ubfx/sbfx/bfi/rev/sxth/pkh/umull-smull register fields/smulwb/smmul/smmlar/qadd/qsub/ssat-usat encodings all agree with this decoder), and the k15_t32_dp.c differential kernels.

Not done unchanged: no phone; T01 corpus thumb rows still need V16; ADC/SBC-with-modified-immediate untestable by assembly; parallel GE flags from the ARM ARM reading only.

Files (mine): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t32_dp.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/{run_tests.sh,gen_enc.py,vectors.s,t_dp.c,check_routing.sh,k15_t32_dp.c,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V15/STATUS.md.
